secrets.name: AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Auth0 Regular Web Application 'Client ID' (Auth0 dashboard -> Applications -> your LunaTicK app -> Settings).

secrets.name: AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Auth0 'Client Secret' from the same application Settings page.

secrets.name: AUTH_COOKIE_SECRET
secrets.description: Long random private value for Streamlit's OIDC session cookie. Must stay stable across restarts.

secrets.name: AUTH0_DATABASE_CONNECTION
secrets.description: Optional Auth0 database connection name; defaults to Username-Password-Authentication when omitted.

secrets.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional: DeepSeek API key used by the Home reading-interpretation feature.
